name: Forum post: theory, the highlighter
when: A fan theory or rumour, quoted as a post and marked as unconfirmed under it. Under it, the footage turns lightly blurred and darkened to 60 % in natural colours as the card rises (`ground`), and sharp again as the card leaves.
anchor: The marker starts (`hl`) on the first highlighted word; the card rises 12 frames after the scene starts.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.post: the post's text as the voice quotes it, 64 characters at most (two lines)
vars.highlight: the words the marker covers, copied exactly from post (one band per word, 3 frames apart), 40 characters at most
vars.photo: the picture in the post, a 16:9 file in the project's assets/ (a still of the place or thing the theory is about)
vars.note: the line under the card that says how sure it is ("Fan match, not confirmed by Rockstar"), 56 characters at most
vars.handle: the real author's handle, only when the user gives it; empty = no handle (never invent one)
vars.avatar: the real author's picture file, only when the user gives it; empty = no circle
vars.meta: after the handle: where and when it was posted, only when known; empty = none. With no handle, picture or meta, the card has no author line
vars.foot: a line under the picture, only when known (replies on a real post); empty = none
vars.hl: seconds after the start: when the marker starts, on the first highlighted word (at least 0.9)
vars.out: seconds after the start: when it starts to leave (the scene ends 0.23 s later)

changed: The invented author line (monogram, handle, community, age) and the invented reply count are gone by default: handle, picture, meta and foot are values, empty unless the user gives real ones; the note sits 46 px (vice 55.6 px) under the card and moves up with a shorter card, at the validated 902 px with the full card. The treated shot is baked from `ground` (blur in on f10-f14 as validated); it turns sharp 2 frames after `out`, and keeps the validated slow push (3 % over 6 s), as in the validated clip. Clean text uses the theme's Inter, which renders a little wider than the Inter the cards lab happened to load (its weights are the validated 500 and 800), so a clean line can wrap one word earlier.
